# StoreFlow
A synthetic existing checkout backend, Python standard library only. Tests: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v.
Public entry points: storefront.preview, checkout.Checkout.place_order, legacy_export.export_subtotal. In-memory catalog, stock, ledger and receipt cache model the same process; no network or persistence. Prices and amounts are integer cents. This fixture is synthetic, not production code.
tests/test_existing.py:
import unittest
from src.storeflow.storefront import preview
from src.storeflow.pricing import calculate_total
from src.storeflow.legacy_export import export_subtotal
from src.storeflow.inventory import Inventory
from src.storeflow.payments import Ledger
from src.storeflow.checkout import Checkout
from src.storeflow.receipts import export_receipt

class ExistingTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_old_preview(self):
        self.assertEqual(preview([("book",2)]), {"subtotal_cents":10000,"discount_cents":0,"total_cents":10000})
    def test_legacy_subtotal(self):
        self.assertEqual(export_subtotal([("bag",2)]), {"gross_cents":30000})
    def test_empty_preview(self):
        self.assertEqual(preview([])["total_cents"],0)
    def test_invalid_line(self):
        for lines in [[("bad",1)],[("book",0)],[("book",-1)],[("book",True)]]:
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):calculate_total(lines)
    def test_successful_order(self):
        inv=Inventory({"book":3});ledger=Ledger();shop=Checkout(inv,ledger)
        r=shop.place_order("old-1",[("book",1)])
        self.assertEqual(export_receipt(r),{"receipt_id":"old-1","amount_cents":5000})
        self.assertEqual(inv.stock["book"],2);self.assertEqual(ledger.charge_count,1)
    def test_repeat_is_cached(self):
        inv=Inventory({"book":1});ledger=Ledger();shop=Checkout(inv,ledger)
        r=shop.place_order("same",[("book",1)])
        self.assertIs(shop.place_order("same",[("book",1)]),r)
        self.assertEqual(ledger.charge_count,1);self.assertEqual(inv.stock["book"],0)
    def test_empty_order(self):
        shop=Checkout(Inventory({"book":2}),Ledger())
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):shop.place_order("empty",[])
